decision.buyer: Cooling and component suppliers (a hypothesis in #342; no customer demand or paid pilot is claimed).
decision.engineering_decision: Choose a channel layout for a single-phase liquid cold plate on a defined chip footprint and heat-load family.
decision.intended_use: Predict plate temperatures, coolant outlet temperature and pressure drop across a parameterized straight or serpentine channel family.

design_variables.description: Parameters of straight or serpentine channels in a fixed external footprint; not arbitrary topology. The parameter list is not yet fixed.
design_variables.name: channel_geometry

design_variables.description: Coolant volume flow; mass or volume flow must be declared explicitly (#342).
design_variables.name: coolant_flow

design_variables.description: Spatial heat flux over the chip footprint.
design_variables.name: heat_load_map

next_experiment: Select a reproducible simple straight-channel baseline and document the geometry-to-mesh-to-solve-to-output commands (#342 first task), then price the first pilot for owner approval.

outputs.description: Solid temperature at declared query points.
outputs.name: solid_temperature

outputs.description: Pressure drop, with its pressure-reference convention declared.
outputs.name: pressure_drop

population.proposed: One single-phase liquid-cooled plate, one material and coolant, fixed external footprint, parameterized straight or serpentine channels (#342). A proposed development design, not a ratified production population.

reference.applicability: Candidate: a pinned OpenFOAM conjugate heat-transfer implementation, to be assessed (#342). Nothing is pinned or run; whether the envelope is laminar is not yet confirmed.

unresolved: Units, coordinate conventions, geometry validity and physical ranges are not yet specified for domain review.
Solver identity, version, licence and redistribution rights are not pinned.
Whether the proposed envelope supports laminar flow is unconfirmed.
#341 proposes 8 ordinary and 4 difficult valid cases with paired refinement of at least 4 as the first engineering pilot; it needs a price and owner approval before it runs.
